grid-0.$description: 0px · No spacing. Use to remove gaps or reset padding. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-1.$description: 1px · Hairline. Borders, dividers and 1px optical adjustments only — not for layout spacing. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-2.$description: 2px · Micro spacing. Icon-to-badge offsets and tight optical fixes. Avoid for layout. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-4.$description: 4px · Extra-small spacing (base unit of the 4px grid). Gap between an icon and its label, or inside compact chips. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-6.$description: 6px · Off-grid step. Use only to match existing production UI; prefer 4 or 8 in new designs. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-8.$description: 8px · Small spacing. Default gap between closely related elements (label and input, stacked text lines). Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-10.$description: 10px · Off-grid step. Use only to match existing production UI; prefer 8 or 12 in new designs. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-12.$description: 12px · Small–medium spacing. Padding inside buttons, chips and list items. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-16.$description: 16px · Base spacing. Default padding for cards and containers, and the gap between components. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-20.$description: 20px · Medium spacing. Padding for larger cards, sheets and modals. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-24.$description: 24px · Medium–large spacing. Gap between content groups; page side margins on mobile. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-28.$description: 28px · Off-grid step. Use only to match existing production UI; prefer 24 or 32 in new designs. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-32.$description: 32px · Large spacing. Gap between sections within a screen. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-36.$description: 36px · Off-grid step. Use only to match existing production UI; prefer 32 or 40 in new designs. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-40.$description: 40px · Large spacing. Section padding on tablet; small component heights. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-44.$description: 44px · Minimum touch target (44px). Use for the height/width of any tappable element. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-48.$description: 48px · Extra-large spacing. Section spacing on desktop; comfortable touch targets. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-52.$description: 52px · Component size. Tall buttons and input fields. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-56.$description: 56px · Component size. Top bars, large buttons and list rows with avatars. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-64.$description: 64px · Layout spacing. Space between major page blocks on desktop. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-72.$description: 72px · Layout spacing. Hero padding and spacing around marketing sections. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-80.$description: 80px · Layout spacing. Large hero and marketing section padding on desktop. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-88.$description: 88px · Layout size. Avatars, thumbnails and fixed-width elements — not for spacing. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-96.$description: 96px · Layout size. Avatars, thumbnails and fixed-width elements — not for spacing. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-104.$description: 104px · Layout size. Avatars, thumbnails and fixed-width elements — not for spacing. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-112.$description: 112px · Layout size. Avatars, thumbnails and fixed-width elements — not for spacing. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-120.$description: 120px · Layout size. Avatars, thumbnails and fixed-width elements — not for spacing. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-124.$description: 124px · Layout size. Large fixed dimensions (cards, media, containers) — not for spacing. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-128.$description: 128px · Layout size. Large fixed dimensions (avatars, media, containers) — not for spacing. Matches LOHP's real H1 height (128px). Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

grid-136.$description: 136px · Layout size. Large fixed dimensions (cards, media, containers) — not for spacing. Part of the 4px baseline spacing scale.

Primary.$description: Main brand color. Logos, key highlights and brand moments.

Secondary.$description: Second brand color. Supporting highlights next to the primary brand color.

Tertiary.$description: Third brand color. Occasional accents and decorative details.

Secondary.$description: Sections and grouped content on top of the main background.

Tertiary.$description: Subtle fills, such as placeholders and inactive areas.

Quaternary.$description: Cards and containers placed on other surfaces.

Overlay.$description: Dark scrim behind modals, sheets and dialogs. Apply with opacity.

Quinary.$description: Extra surface level for nested content.

Pale.$description: Soft brand-tinted background for highlights and banners.

Secondary.$description: Emphasis borders, such as selected or brand-tinted outlines.

Success.$description: Success messages, confirmations and positive feedback.

Error.$description: Errors, validation messages and failed actions.

Warning.$description: Warnings and cautions that need attention.

Primary.$description: Main text for headings and body copy.

Secondary.$description: Supporting text: descriptions, hints and metadata.

Tertiary.$description: Text on filled or brand-colored surfaces, such as primary buttons.
Icons on filled or brand-colored surfaces.

Success.$description: Success icons, such as checkmarks and confirmations.

Default.$description: Primary button fill. Main action on a screen.
Accent (call-to-action) button fill. High-attention actions such as start or buy.
Secondary button fill. Alternative or less important actions.
